supersedes: klines-daily-btcusdt-spot-v3 (FAIL: beat cash but not buy-and-hold; test window spent). The owner has since decided that holding BTC is not an option, so the benchmark is cash.
hypothesis: A single slow trend filter on BTCUSDT (long while price is above its 2400-hour average, otherwise cash) earns a positive after-cost return with a moderate drawdown.
origin: Chosen from the exploration in klines_exploration_2018_2023.md (64 rule variants, data to 2023-12-31 only). That exploration is not evidence; this spec fixes one rule and tests it on later data.
position_scope: long or flat, fully invested when long, no leverage, no shorting, paper research only

data_source.files: https://data.binance.vision/data/spot/monthly/klines/BTCUSDT/1h/BTCUSDT-1h-YYYY-MM.zip (and the daily/ files for days after the last full month)
data_source.checksum: every zip verified against its .CHECKSUM (sha256) before use
data_source.timestamp_unit: milliseconds before 2025, microseconds from 2025; the runner normalises to UTC hours
data_source.gaps: bars are used in order as published; missing hours are counted and reported; a gap longer than 24 hours inside an evaluated segment is an error

rule.name: sma_band
rule.definition: sma = mean of the last 2400 closes including the current bar. State becomes long when close > sma * 1.02, flat when close < sma * 0.98, otherwise unchanged. Initial state flat. No state until 2400 closes exist.
rule.parameter_search: none; one configuration. Any other rule or parameter is a new spec version.

clock.signal: state after the close of bar i
clock.execution: that state is held from the open of bar i+1 to the open of bar i+2
clock.warmup: the state may use closes before a segment start (past data only)

execution_and_costs.applied: equity is multiplied by (1 - 0.0012) on every entry and every exit

segments_utc.rules: each segment starts flat; no entry in its first 24 hours (embargo); an open position is closed at the segment end with exit cost

metrics: annualised Sharpe of hourly net returns (mean/std * sqrt(8760))
max drawdown of the equity curve
baselines: buy_and_hold with costs - reported for information only, not used for pass/fail

backcheck_evaluation.enforcement: runner refuses a second backcheck run (exclusive marker file next to the data)
backcheck_evaluation.contamination: This rule has never been run on 2024-01-01..2026-11-01, but v3 already showed that period: BTC buy-and-hold made +83% and a 30-day momentum rule +28.5%. A pass here is therefore weaker than a clean test and is labelled so.
backcheck_evaluation.if_fail: stop this hypothesis; no forward phase
backcheck_evaluation.if_pass: the rule is eligible for the forward phase; it is not a profitability claim

forward_evaluation.what: the same runner on klines published after this spec was committed; no orders, no VPS, paper only
forward_evaluation.runs: verdict is computed once, on the full forward segment after 2027-11-17
forward_evaluation.interim_reads: allowed for information; they never change the rule, costs or criteria. Any change is a new spec and the forward window restarts.

known_limits: About 3 round trips a year: a one-year forward window holds only a handful of trades, so even a pass is weak statistical evidence.
The rule was picked as the best of 64 explored variants; part of its 2018-2023 result is selection luck.
The backcheck period is not fully unseen (see contamination).
Next-open fills ignore slippage beyond the 2 bp/side adjustment; fine for BTCUSDT spot at research size, not proof of live capacity.
In a long sideways or falling market the rule sits in cash or takes repeated small losses; positive return is not guaranteed in any given year.
